description: This file declares non-symbolic signatures for various tensor operations in the ATen/native namespace, including reshaping, slicing, sparse tensor creation, loss functions, and backward operations related to embedding bags and other tensor manipulations. It serves as a declaration file for certain functions used within the PyTorch framework, providing non-symbolic signatures for native operations, especially for static runtime and backward compatibility.
